_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); railroad signals

pit_profile.why: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not

classification.quality_note: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 0.55x; +20% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.41; conservative 2yr +11%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -7.7%/yr (worst year FY13-FY22, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-4.4%/yr (Q3 2023 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +10.1%/yr (FY13-FY22 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +24.9%/yr (best 2-yr run FY13-FY22); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: UNP (retrospective, 2023-10-27) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.55x (22.2% downside to Bear $157 / +40.3% upside to Bull $283) | Adj composite 1.25 vs market 2.66: gap -1.41 [OVERVALUED] | +20% above the EPP floor $168 (15x FY23E $11.21) | Conservative 2-yr case: +10.9% total (+5.4%/yr) | At 18.0x FY23E the 15% hurdle price $267 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; carloads -3% in Q3 2023, forward revenue -9% (no FY23 revenue guide, Q3 2023 freight revenue); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
